artefacts.title: 145 - Comunicacion de datos al pagador (formulario publicado, PDF)
artefacts.content_dating_evidence: The form's own data-protection footer cites 'el articulo 11 de la Ley Organica 3/2018, de 5 de diciembre'. AEAT publishes this artefact at a stable, unversioned URL as the CURRENT form, so the capture cannot be dated from its filename or URL; this citation is the only internal lower bound the document carries.
